payload.reason: The evidence provides specific sources from which the data was aggregated, including various literary, religious, and journalistic texts, as well as personal libraries and public-domain sources.

claims.text: The data sources included varied text from conversational, literary, religious sources, news magazines, a book of proverbs, and a Human Rights declaration.
Text was aggregated from a variety of online public-domain sources and physical books from personal libraries using Optical Character Recognition (OCR) software.
The dataset was significantly grown from a majority Biblical text corpus to millions of tokens from over a dozen sources, including modern journalistic news text.
Global Voices, a corpus of journalistic news text, was selected as part of the test set for the research experiments.
